entities.summary: With around 7,000 students, Karlsruhe University of Applied Sciences is the second largest university of applied sciences in the German federal state of Baden-Württemberg. It is a founding member of the Doctoral Association of Universities of Applied Sciences Baden-Württemberg established in 2022 and a member of the INGENIUM European University.
